text: Keeping disaster-response resource allocations synchronized with fast-changing physical ground reality.
“No operational allocation may outlive its physical ground truth.”
Search proposes. CAS disposes. Invalidation rematches.

Living Incident Twins · Vernacular Lexical Search · Vector kNN
2dsphere Spatial Geometries · Single-Document OCC · Change Streams
Authoritative transactional state coordinator bridging awareness and logistics.
Closed Operating Loop: Ingest → Twin → 4-R Retrieval → OCC Commit → Invalidate → Rematch

ReliefMesh: Operational Crisis Coordination Engine. Master submission for MongoDB Hackathon 2026. Central thesis: Keeping disaster-response allocations synchronized with changing physical reality via MongoDB Atlas as the unified operational core.
Disaster response breaks when operational state drifts from reality.
The failure is not lack of inbound data. It is stale, fragmented, and inconsistent operational state.

Blood Bank: 5 units available

OPERATIONS VIEW

2 dispatch decisions
1 scarce resource

FAILURE: PHANTOM ALLOCATION — 45 mins wasted through debris, patient dies in transit.

DISPATCH TIME (02:00)
Highway 4: Marked Safe ✓
Supply convoy launched
Static route cached
Zero stream reactivity

MUTATION (02:15)
Levee breaches 2.4km north
Flood perimeter expands
Highway submerged
DISPATCHED ROUTE INVALID!
FAILURE: BLIND ROUTING — Rescue crew enters submerged corridor unaware. Rescuers become victims.
Physical reality changes faster than coordination state. Point-in-time reads become deadly falsehoods without transactional controls.
Different systems know different parts of the incident. Ushahidi crowdsources distress; Sahana logs warehouses — neither coordinates.
Teams act on inventory or route information that is no longer valid. Relational lock contention deadlocks during peak emergencies.
THE CORE PROBLEM: KEEPING OPERATIONAL DECISIONS FRESH.

Disaster response breaks when operational state drifts from reality. The core problem is not inbound data collection; it is keeping allocation decisions fresh. Traditional disconnected architectures produce phantom allocations and blind routings.
ReliefMesh closes the loop between awareness, allocation and changing reality.

Understand what the request means even when field terminology differs from inventory terminology. Degrades gracefully if embedding APIs fail.

REQUEST LOCATION  ───►  NEARBY DEPOTS
Radius Filter (50km) → OSRM Road LineString

HAZARD CHECK: 2dsphere $geoIntersects
Candidate A: Intersects flood polygon ✕ (Pruned!)
Candidate B: Safe path verified ✓ (Approved)
Visual: Route LineString vs Flood Barrier Polygon
A nearby resource is not necessarily reachable. Euclidean proximity is deceptive; ReliefMesh prunes routes intersecting dynamic hazard barriers before allocation.

DEPOT STATE: 5 UNITS AVAILABLE
Dispatcher A: 4 units → COMMIT ✓ (OCC __v: 1)
Dispatcher B: 4 units → PREDICATE FAIL ✕

FAILED PREDICATE → IMMEDIATE REMATCH
Automated jittered re-query to alternate depot
OCC + Conditional Atomic CAS + ACID Transactions
Candidate retrieval proposes. Authoritative state is revalidated at commit time. Prevents phantom allocations without heavyweight multi-table locking.
Eventual consistency for candidate discovery; authoritative atomic predicates for resource commitment.
RELIEFMESH IS NOT A DISASTER MAP.
IT IS A REACTIVE OPERATIONAL COORDINATION LOOP.
RELIEFMESH · DOMAIN ARCHITECTURE · THE 4-R OPERATIONAL SPINE

ReliefMesh closes the loop between awareness, allocation, and changing reality via 4 operational gates: Relevant (Search/Vector/Synonyms), Reachable (2dsphere route checks), Reserved (Single-document OCC), and Resilient (Delta-scoped invalidation).
• AI Layer: Whisper Speech + Embeddings API

PostgreSQL Stack (5 Distributed Systems):
PostgreSQL + PostGIS + pgvector + Debezium + Kafka

ReliefMesh Stack (1 Managed Control Plane):
MongoDB Atlas: Search + Vector + Geo + OCC + Streams

Trade-off Reality: pgRouting is superior for road graphs, so we delegate routing to OSRM. MongoDB's win is the integrated reactive loop without Kafka sprawl.
Living Incidents, inventory, active missions & dynamic hazard bounds.
Lucene tokenization + dynamic synonym mappings (disaster dialects).
1536-dim cosine similarity for unstructured distress semantic intent.
Single-document OCC (__v) + Multi-doc ACID only where required.
Pre/Post-images for delta-scoped dynamic invalidation & rerouting.
Atlas Stream Processing: windowed rate-of-rise ($derivative) alerts.
MongoDB connects retrieval, spatial safety, allocation and reactivity in one operational plane.
RELIEFMESH · TECHNOLOGY STACK & MONGODB ATLAS CORE

MongoDB Atlas serves as the unified operational control plane, integrating Document State, Atlas Search, Vector Search, Geospatial Indexing, OCC Allocation, and Change Streams. Replaces 5 independent distributed components with one unified engine.
One request travels through four operational gates.

FIELD REPORT: “need khoon o-neg” (Dialect SMS/Audio)
↓
SYNONYM MAPPING: “khoon” → “blood”, “dawa” → “medicine”
↓
ADAPTIVE RETRIEVAL: Named $rankFusion (Uniform RRF)
• Combines Lucene Keyword + OpenAI 1536-dim Embedding
• Degrades gracefully to lexical + proximity if embedding API is down
Annotation: Self-healing probe ($searchMeta) widens geo radius if matches < 3.

CANDIDATE DEPOTS → 2dsphere Geo Filter (50km radius)
↓
OSRM ROUTE GENERATION: Produces turn-by-turn LineString
↓
HAZARD POLYGON CHECK: 2dsphere $geoIntersects on perimeters
↓
SAFE CANDIDATE COMMITTED | FLOODED CANDIDATE PRUNED
ARCHITECTURAL RULE: EUCLIDEAN NEARBY ≠ ROAD REACHABLE.

DEPOT INVENTORY: 5 UNITS AVAILABLE
• Request A (4 units) → CAS match on __v → COMMIT ✓
• Request B (4 units) → Predicate fail (modifiedCount: 0) ✕

THUNDERING HERD DEFENSE:
• Losers execute immediate client rematch across randomized top-3 window
• Exponential backoff with full jitter prevents depot clumping

ACTIVE MISSION: Convoy in transit ────────► Hospital
FLOOD PERIMETER EXPANDS: Old Polygon  ──►  Expanded Polygon
↓
CHANGE STREAM WITH PRE/POST-IMAGES:
• Spatial Delta Diff: Evaluates ONLY the new expansion zone
• 2dsphere $geoIntersects detects route compromised in real-time
• Immediate trigger: Flags mission & dispatches instant reroute

Every relief request passes through 4 operational gates: Relevant (vernacular synonyms and rankFusion), Reachable (OSRM route checked against 2dsphere hazard polygons), Reserved (single-document OCC with version guard), and Resilient (pre/post-image delta-scoped invalidation and dynamic reroute).
